newsitem.title: FINLAND: Economy on summit lunchtime agenda - White House.
newsitem.headline: Economy on summit lunchtime agenda - White House.

text.p: Economic issues were the main topic on the agenda for lunchtime talks between U.S. President Bill Clinton and Russian President Boris Yeltsin, the White House said on Friday.

"They quickly agreed they would devote most of their time at lunch to economic issues and to the progress of economic and political reform in Russia," White House spokesman Mike McCurry told reporters after the morning session of the summit.

Talks were covering "a full range of things related to economic liberalisation, assistance for the transition occurring in the Russian Federation (and) how international financial institutions can be helpful," he said.
Ahead of the summit, officials said Washington might offer Russia more help in fighting organised crime and in moving the country towards a market economy.
